announcements.title: Strategy Builder is here!
announcements.body: Pick option legs straight from the chain and see the expiry payoff before you fire - breakevens, max profit and max loss, all computed on your own data. Find it on the F&O tab, or from the chain's builder icon. Paper orders only, as always.

announcements.title: Video lessons are here!
announcements.body: 5 short videos: why price moves, how candles form, supply-demand zones on a real NIFTY chart, how your broker keys stay on your phone, and the Strategy Lab. They download on demand and play offline - find them in Learn.
